verdict.rationale: Chip vendors commonly ship official command-line tooling for their silicon, so this story applies to the Apple M5. However, the evidence only covers frameworks and APIs (Metal 4, Core ML, MLX, Foundation Models) and a GUI Metal debugger, with no official CLI for AI-native workflows. The llms.txt probe returned 404, and nothing else in the pack shows a CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
